en.meta.title: Vehicle Registration Upload Guide
en.page.title: How to upload your Vehicle Registration
en.page.intro: Having trouble with the Vehicle Registration step in the app? Follow the steps below — each numbered marker on the screenshots shows exactly what to tap or fill in.
en.step1.title: Go to the Vehicles section
en.step1.body: In the registration app, open the Vehicles section and scroll down to Vehicle Registration Details.
en.step2.title: Fill in the Vehicle Registration Details
en.step2.body: Follow the numbered markers below in order to complete this section.
en.legend.upload: Tap here to upload a clear photo of your vehicle registration card.
en.legend.docnum: Type your Plate Number here, exactly as printed on your plate.
en.legend.expiry: Select the expiry date shown on your registration card.
en.legend.save: Tap Save once everything looks correct.
en.step3.title: Find your Plate Number
en.step3.body: Your Plate Number is printed on your vehicle's physical license plate, as shown below. Marker 2 matches the same number from the form in step 2.
en.legend.platenum: Plate number — type this into the Document Number field.
en.step4.title: Find the expiry date on your registration card
en.step4.body: Not sure where to look? Marker 3 below matches the same number from the form in step 2.
en.legend.cardexpiry: Expiry date — select this same date in the Expiry Date field.
en.step5.title: Save
en.step5.body: Once everything matches, tap Save (marker 4 in step 2). Your Vehicle Registration step is now complete.
en.tips.title: Before you save
en.tips.item1: Make sure the registration card photo is clear, well-lit, and shows all four corners.
en.tips.item2: Double-check that the Plate Number you type matches your physical plate and registration card exactly.
en.tips.item3: Confirm your registration hasn't expired — you'll need to renew it with your state DMV first if it has.
en.footer.help: Still having trouble? Contact support from within the app for further assistance.
